terminologyReview: Guideline clarification: the revised distinction in references/common.md and references/ga.md is correct. The evidence agrees on three points. intl-workerd.json shows Intl.ListFormat and Intl.RelativeTimeFormat unsupported (English output) for eo, be and ga, while Intl.PluralRules returns native categories for all 18 locales. InstructionTemplates (packages/shared/src/instruction-template.ts) builds Intl.PluralRules for the content language and throws when a catalog omits a native count variant or a message. BotText.andList and transcriptLabelList join items only through the catalog's formatting.* patterns. So Bickr's own formatters never 'silently return English'; the English fallback is only a property of the platform Intl list and relative-time formatters, which Bickr does not use for these strings. One leftover: references/eo.md line 7 still says 'The runtime formatters silently return English, although plural rules work.' It should use the same wording as common.md and ga.md (be.md already does). This is a guideline edit only and changes no frozen English unit.

Chinese terminology follows the lead decisions. 标识 is used for handle in 11 units, with no 账号名 left. 组合标记 is used for Unicode marks (no 标记字符 left), 结束 for ending a visit, and 不得超过 for every required upper bound (system.main limits, structured_output.maximum.*, textTooLong). The capacity formula 最多只能 remains only in issue.note.references, where the source says "can refer to at most", which is correct. 完成 remains only where the source says finish or complete an action. The content tag stays zh-Hans per the common reference.

grok.terminologyReview: The revised Workers boundary is correct. Intl.ListFormat and Intl.RelativeTimeFormat fall back to English for Esperanto, Belarusian, and Irish, while Intl.PluralRules supports native categories. Bickr catalog formatters use explicit translated patterns and reject a missing entry, so the older phrase that runtime formatters silently return English does not describe Bickr. Chinese is outside that fallback set and uses other for every count. A handle is 标识. Unicode marks are 组合标记, distinct from the self-author 标记. Ending a visit is 结束. A required maximum uses 不得超过, while a can-include limit uses 最多可以. 不要 and 必须 keep prohibitions and requirements. Narration uses 我, and instructions use 你 where a pronoun is needed.
